result.brief: 提出 PoolDINO 仿射池化算子，压缩 RAE 的 DINO 密集 token 网格，在保持两阶段 RAE 流程下提升扩散生成效率。
result.reason: Introduces PoolDINO, a learned affine pooling operator for Representation Autoencoders, compressing dense DINO token grids while preserving RAE two-stage training—directly a RAE/generative latent-space representation contribution.
